choice.en: You have three choices: a) an arm, b) a beard, or c) some jeans.
choice.zh: You have three choices: a) an arm, b) a beard, or c) some jeans.

choice.en: More choice does not really lead to better cooking.
choice.zh: 更多的选择并没有真正带来更好的烹饪。

choice.en: The most obvious choice is fish and chips: fried fish, usually cod or haddock, with thick-cut chips served with salt and vinegar.
choice.zh: 最明显的选择是炸鱼薯条：炸鱼，通常是鳕鱼或黑线鳕，配上厚切薯条，佐以盐和醋。

chamber.en: In January of this year, January of 2026, the German Chancellor, Friedrich Merz, stood in front of the Chamber of Industry and Commerce in Dessau and admitted, in no uncertain terms , that his country, Germany, had made a mistake.
chamber.zh: 今年1月，也就是2026年1月，德国总理 Friedrich Merz 站在德绍工商会面前，毫不含糊地承认他的国家——德国，犯了一个错误。

chicken.en: People would also potentially have dairy products from cows and sheep, and perhaps keep chickens or other animals.
chicken.zh: 人们还可能拥有来自牛和羊的乳制品，也许还养鸡或其他动物。

chicken.en: Chicken tikka masala is perhaps the most famous example.
chicken.zh: 鸡肉蒂卡玛莎拉也许是最著名的例子。

chip.en: British cuisine, though, is associated with pubs and fish and chips and fried breakfasts.
chip.zh: 然而，英国菜却与酒吧、炸鱼薯条和炸早餐联系在一起。

chip.en: Potatoes originated in South America. But nobody seriously argues that fish and chips isn’t British.
chip.zh: 土豆起源于南美洲。但没有人严肃地争辩说炸鱼薯条不是英国的。

challenge.en: Perhaps the best challenge to the idea that British food is bland is found in “curry”.
challenge.zh: 对英国食物平淡无奇这一观点的最好挑战也许可以在“咖喱”中找到。

chain.en: The issue is that people often go to chain restaurants or places that are known for selling cheap, mass-produced food.
chain.zh: 问题在于人们经常去连锁餐厅或以出售便宜、大规模生产的食物而闻名的地方。
